Seven killed in multi-storey Delhi hostel collapse; rescue efforts ongoing

A multi-storey hostel in Delhi collapsed, resulting in the deaths of seven people. Twelve individuals were rescued from the debris. The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) stated that the exact number of people trapped inside the collapsed structure is not yet known. Rescue operations are continuing at the site.
